longs.thesis: Q3 revenue $3.66B, +168% YoY, beat the $3.54B estimate; raised 2026 revenue guidance to $13.0-13.3B; backlog $132.5B, +138% YoY. Gap-up with a real fundamental driver after a bruising stretch (down >38% YTD).

Q3 results: returned to sales growth for the first time in four years, gross margin expanded, swung to adjusted net income; raised FY2026 sales and margin guidance. Gapping above its 52-week high ($8.07, Nov 6) - clean breakout level on an earnings beat.
CoreWeave's results are easing AI-bubble fears and NVDA is CoreWeave's key backer. Mean-reversion bounce after a two-day slide of more than 9%, not a breakout - watch whether it reclaims the slide.
Memory-chip rally: TSMC's October revenue +59.7% YoY; SNDK +8%, STX/WDC +7% across semis. Bounce off a weak week (PHLX Semis fell 5.7%) with a sector-wide tailwind.
Neocloud sympathy with CRWV's beat; +12-15% premarket to ~$154. Reports Q3 before Thursday's open - earnings tomorrow is event risk, size accordingly.

shorts.thesis: Q3 miss: revenue $1.41M vs $3.52M expected, -28% YoY; wider-than-expected loss; FY2026 revenue guide below estimates. Bouncing +3% premarket with quantum peers - a fade-the-bounce candidate, not a clean gap-down short.

Parabolic low-float runner reversing after +198% over five sessions (+1,132% YTD); -49% premarket with no fresh catalyst. Avoid chasing either side; the collapse is momentum unwinding, not a defined short setup.
Day's top gainer (+77% premarket) but avoid: no catalyst in published coverage. Low-float name already +485% Monday and +62.5% Tuesday, with repeated volatility halts. Do not chase.
